card.description: Obelisk of Resonance: a 12‑meter monolithic basalt shaft, tapering to a 1.5‑meter square base, crowned with a 3‑meter copper‑plated finial etched with spiraling Ethiopian/Egyptian glyphs. At its heart lies a 5‑meter crystalline core that, when activated, emits a soft blue bio‑luminescent glow, channeling energy through copper conduits into a lattice of brass filaments that form a protective shield. The obelisk serves as the central power node of the subterranean citadel, interfacing ancient mystic technology with incomprehensible, advanced circuitry.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** 12‑meter basalt shaft tapering to a 1.5‑meter square base, 3‑meter copper‑plated crown etched with spiraling glyphs.
**Face/Sensors:** Translucent quartz lenses embedded in the crown act as sensors, reflecting light and emitting a faint green glow.
**Clothing/Armor:** A lattice of brass filaments surrounds the obelisk, forming a protective shield with embedded runic plates that pulse with energy.

**Key Features:** Central 5‑meter crystalline core emitting soft blue bio‑luminescence; copper inlay channels; bio‑luminescent glyphs that shift; energy conduits humming; ancient Ethiopian/Egyptian hieroglyphic carvings; dust‑laden air; subtle steam vents.
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial Activation): The obelisk’s core is dormant, with faint glyphs etched but no luminescence.
Phase 2 (Full Resonance): The core activates, glyphs pulse, energy hums, bio‑luminescent glow intensifies, protective shield extends.
props: Item: Obsidian Lens Array – a set of obsidian lenses that focus energy.
